prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
engine_stated_criteria: Udemy — Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self
answer_verbatim:
If you want **structured online courses** for **shadow work**, the strongest options in the results are Jung Platform’s *Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work*, Awake Academy’s *Embracing The Shadow* with Charlie Morley, and ShadowWork.com’s *Basic Facilitator Training Online* for a more practitioner-oriented path.[2][15][9]

For a broader mix of **shadow work plus spiritual practice**, Insight Timer’s *Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing And Growth* and *Shadow Work Toolkit For Deep Inner Healing* are the most directly relevant because Insight Timer specializes in meditation and inner-growth content.[6][18]

A practical shortlist:

- **Jung Platform — Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work**: best if you want a classic Jungian framework and a more psychological approach to the shadow.[2]
- **Awake Academy — Embracing The Shadow**: best if you want a spiritually oriented course taught by Charlie Morley, who is known for combining shadow work with contemplative practice.[15]
- **ShadowWork.com — Basic Facilitator Training Online**: best if you want a more formal training path and possibly to support others, not just personal practice.[9]
- **Insight Timer — Shadow Work courses/toolkits**: best if you want guided practices, meditation, and accessible daily spiritual exercises.[6][18]
- **Udemy — Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** and related shadow-work courses: best if you want a lower-cost, self-paced introduction with lots of options.[3][8][11][13][17]

If you want a **credential-style course**, the results also include **Centre of Excellence — Shadow Mastery Diploma Course** and **Courses for Success — Shadow Work Practitioner Online Certificate Course**.[4][5] These are more course-platform style offerings than spiritually focused mentorship programs.

For **best overall fit**, I’d group them this way:

| Goal | Best match |
|---|---|
| Deep Jungian shadow work | Jung Platform[2] |
| Spiritual practice + shadow integration | Awake Academy / Insight Timer[15][6][18] |
| Facilitator or practitioner track | ShadowWork.com / Courses for Success[9][5] |
| Budget-friendly self-study | Udemy courses[3][8][11][13][17] |

One caution: “shadow work” courses vary a lot in quality and depth, and the search results here are mostly course listings rather than independent reviews, so the best choice depends on whether you want **psychological depth, spiritual practice, certification, or affordability**.[1][10][12][16]
